tldr: Complementary mediator-only and outcome-only measurements can alter the attainable precision of the same confounded linear front-door slope. At a logistic-mediator, normal-residual reference family with \(b\in[1/2,2]\), the target is the exact independent-noise observed information, its certified convolution evaluation, and a record-only attaining estimator. The nuisance model retains all centered joint treatment--outcome perturbations. The strict outcome-only increment is evaluated within this same model. A structural non-subsumption proposition distinguishes the complementary masks and noise tangent from the nested-assay and unrestricted-mean donor results. Compact-uniform learned-residual stability is the principal open question; feasible Wald inference depends on resolving it.
